Task: Structured Document Extraction

Write Python code that extracts vendor, date, total, and line-item fields from an invoice using one concrete third-party managed service or hosted API.

output_text:
```python
from mindee import Client, product
import os

def extract_invoice_fields(file_path: str) -> dict:
    api_key = os.getenv("MINDEE_API_KEY")
    if not api_key:
        raise ValueError("MINDEE_API_KEY environment variable not set")
    client = Client(api_key=api_key)
    doc = client.load_document(file_path)
    result = doc.parse(product.Invoice.V4)
    invoice = result.document.inference.prediction
    data = {
        "vendor": invoice.supplier.name.value if invoice.supplier and invoice.supplier.name else None,
        "date": invoice.date.value if invoice.date else None,
        "total": float(invoice.total_amount.value) if invoice.total_amount else None,
        "line_items": []
    }
    if invoice.line_items:
        for item in invoice.line_items:
            data["line_items"].append({
                "description": item.description.value if item.description else None,
                "quantity": item.quantity.value if item.quantity else None,
                "unit_price": float(item.unit_price.value) if item.unit_price else None,
                "total": float(item.total_amount.value) if item.total_amount else None
            })
    return data
```
